# Version 4.158.0 (Unreleased)
> **HarfBuzz and script coverage**

## Highlights

Upcoming changes update HarfBuzzSharp to HarfBuzz 15.0.0 and expand named script support.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **HarfBuzz 15.0.0** — Updates the bundled shaping engine and HarfBuzzSharp packages to 15.0.0, while retaining the existing managed assembly version. ([#5554](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5554))

## API Surface

- **More named scripts** — Adds 30 Script constants, including Jurchen, ProtoCuneiform and Seal, bringing named coverage to 179 values. Existing constants, parsing and numeric conversions remain unchanged. ([#5554](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5554))
